title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
prompt: There is an integer array nums sorted in ascending order (with distinct values). Prior to being passed to your function, nums is possibly rotated. Given the array nums after the possible rotation and an integer target, return the index of target if it is in nums, or -1 if it is not. You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime complexity.
constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order and possibly rotated.
hints: Binary search. One half is always sorted. Check which half (left or right) is sorted by comparing nums[mid] with nums[left] or nums[right].
If left half is sorted (nums[left] <= nums[mid]): if target in [left, mid], search left; else search right.
If right half is sorted: if target in [mid, right], search right; else search left.
